default: plain `go build` of the idiomatic source, the baseline
optimized: same source, flags only: -s -w, no inlining, no bounds checks, GOEXPERIMENT=nogreenteagc,nosizespecializedmalloc, a padding-free 64 KB page layout (external lld link on arm64) or -funcalign=1 (amd64), then strip of the section headers
upx: Linux only: the static gc build (CGO off, -s -w, -l -B, same GOEXPERIMENT), stripped, then compressed with UPX --best --lzma and unpacked in memory at run time
tinygo: the idiomatic source built with TinyGo's small runtime instead of gc, without bounds checks, then stripped
extreme: Go logic compiled by TinyGo with no runtime, raw syscalls, one segment at 0x400000 and a golfed overlapping ELF header with the string, entry glue and exit code in header holes (hello arm64 reads its exit number out of the ignored upper bits of p_flags)
